geometry.scope: Single static cup+saucer prop; optional static coffee surface, no fluid or detachable parts

candidateCollider.status: Proposal only; no small-item gameplay physics specified

authoringNotes.design: Soft cream glazed ceramic cup with an actual hollow profile and curved handle; terracotta-edged matching saucer
authoringNotes.pivot: Bottom-centre of saucer; Blender Z-up/-Y-front; GLB Y-up/+Z-front
authoringNotes.placement: Place the root on the supporting tabletop or cloth top surface. Cup and saucer are one reusable static asset.
authoringNotes.scope: Default cup contains a static coffee disk. This does not implement drinking, fill states or interaction physics.
